Approved evidence

Regulated Advice Bench

benchmark.regulated-advice-bench

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual full creator-card read at8bc98898cb27af227328b93c9a368b47aca52bca covers benchmark identity/configurations, item-versus-translation units, synthetic construction, blinded English expert labeling, agreement denominators, sampling/translation limitations and explicit CC-BY-NC-SA4.0 release terms. One named RegulatedAdviceBench family includes tax/legal configurations and nine-language rows; neither configs nor translations create independent family credits. The original five exact qualified statements have separate source-content author/verifier/adversarial receipts. Full private policies, row payloads and real legal validity remain outside review; source reports are not a professional-advice or regulatory certification.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Regulated Advice Bench · documents: The card reports tax nominal alpha 0.628 on 318 doubly read items including 58 ties excluded from release, and legal alpha 0.714 on 257 doubly judged items including ties.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.regulated-advice-bench.agreement-denominators

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Agreement samples are different from the 338/332 released-item denominators; the stated intervals and raw agreement remain sample-specific.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Regulated Advice Bench · documents: The card describes synthetic dialogue pairs followed by regulatory expert review of English replies: four tax reviewers and five legal reviewers, with two per item where possible, blind to the AI label.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.benchmark.regulated-advice-bench.synthetic-expert-label-process

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Items without a verdict are excluded and translations inherit the English verdict. This is not nine independent human judgments per item or naturally collected legal advice.
